tools.name: add_timeline_cue
tools.description: Creates a new manual timeline marker at a specified timestamp with an optional descriptive label.

time.description: Timestamp in seconds for the marker

tools.name: analyze_timeline
tools.description: Analyzes the temporal hierarchy and layer layout of a Vide DSL script, returning timing extents, simultaneous layer densities, and potential timeline warnings.

code.description: Vide DSL script code to analyze (defaults to active editor script)

tools.name: capture_frame_screenshot
tools.description: Renders a single video frame at a given timestamp on an in-memory canvas and returns a base64 PNG image for visual inspection by multimodal AI models.

code.description: Optional custom Vide DSL script code (defaults to active script)

tools.name: control_playback
tools.description: Controls the video timeline playback (play, pause, toggle, seek to timestamp, step frames, and set loop mode).

frames.description: Frame count for step (positive or negative)

tools.name: create_script
tools.description: Creates and opens a new Vide DSL script file in the editor.

tools.name: delete_project_file
tools.description: Deletes a specified file from the project directory.

path.description: Path of the file to remove

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Renders the specified or active Vide DSL script into an MP4 video using browser-accelerated WebCodecs / Mediabunny. Automatically opens the Studio export modal showing live progress, saves the output to the exports/ directory, and returns the output metadata and file size.

code.description: Optional custom Vide DSL code (defaults to active script)

tools.name: get_active_script
tools.description: Returns the current Vide DSL script defining the active video timeline.

tools.name: get_asset_metadata
tools.description: Returns metadata, user notes, tags, tempo (BPM), spoken transcript, and visual descriptions for a given asset path.

tools.name: get_dsl_reference
tools.description: Returns the full reference of built-in DSL primitives (text, math, circle, rect, line, path, arc, group, parallel, sequence, animate, fade, output).

tools.name: get_scene_settings
tools.description: Returns the current video dimensions, frame rate, duration, and background color.

tools.name: get_video_script
tools.description: Alias for get_active_script. Returns the current Vide DSL script.

tools.name: inspect_layers_at_time
tools.description: Returns a detailed list of all visual and audio elements active at a specific timestamp in the timeline.

tools.name: list_open_scripts
tools.description: Lists all open script files in the editor tabs.

tools.name: list_project_files
tools.description: Lists all media files, assets, images, videos, scripts, and attached user notes / tags in the active local project folder.

tools.name: list_timeline_cues
tools.description: Lists all defined timeline cue points, scene markers, and IDE breakpoints with their timestamps and labels.

tools.name: read_project_file
tools.description: Reads text or DSL source code of a specified relative file path from the project directory.

tools.name: save_active_script
tools.description: Saves current modifications of the active script to disk and storage.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Searches project media assets using semantic keyword matching against filenames, user notes, tags, visual descriptions, and spoken transcripts.

tools.name: search_vide_docs
tools.description: Search the local knowledge base for Vide DSL syntax, primitives, math formulas, easing curves, and composition rules.

query.description: What you are trying to build or animate

tools.name: search_vide_documentation
tools.description: Alias for search_vide_docs. Search the local vector database for Vide DSL syntax and features.

query.description: What you are trying to do

tools.name: seek_to_cue
tools.description: Positions playback and playhead at a specific cue point, breakpoint, or line number timestamp.

cue_id.description: ID of the cue to jump to

label.description: Label of the cue point to find

line.description: Line number in code editor to jump to its timestamp

tools.name: set_active_script_code
tools.description: Updates the active Vide DSL script in the editor and triggers preview compilation.

new_code.description: The complete Vide DSL script code

run.description: Whether to compile and trigger playback immediately

reasoning.description: Agent explanation to show on the studio banner

tools.name: set_asset_notes
tools.description: Attaches semantic notes, tags, visual description, audio tempo (BPM), or transcripts to a media asset, allowing the agent and user to index and search content accurately.

notes.description: User or AI description of the asset (e.g. "A heavy freight train passing by")

visualDescription.description: Visual depiction for video or image assets

bpm.description: Music tempo in beats per minute

tools.name: switch_active_script
tools.description: Switches the editor view to a specific open script by its tab ID.

tools.name: update_video_script
tools.description: Alias for set_active_script_code. Updates the Vide DSL script.

new_script.description: The new Vide DSL script code

tools.name: validate_script
tools.description: Parses and validates a Vide DSL script in a dry-run sandbox, returning duration, resolution, or exact syntax errors without modifying the active workspace.

tools.name: write_project_file
tools.description: Creates or updates a script or text file directly inside the local project folder.
